# GoogleTest
Vendored GoogleTest 1.17.0 (GoogleMock is not included in the build).
Source: https://github.com/google/googletest/releases/tag/v1.17.0
Archive SHA-256: 40D4EC942217DCC84A9EBE2A68584ADA7D4A33A8EE958755763278EA1C5E18FF
Only upstream include/, src/ and LICENSE are shipped. Build gtest-all.cc with
the same MSVC runtime and architecture as the test executable. No network
access is required during builds. Do not modify upstream sources.
